title: Glenn Wichman, Michael Toy & Ken Arnold - Rogue panel
speaker: Glenn Wichman, Michael Toy & Ken Arnold
description:
This talk is from the 2016 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event.html, re-uploaded 2021.

The three original creators of Rogue will have a panel discussion about rogue and its history, moderated by David Craddock. They will discuss the game's development and their process as well as its legacy, before opening the floor for questions from the audience.
